sentence: On the research question - whether credit spreads on corporate bonds move before the rating agencies act - the engine's answer on this dataset is PARTIAL [E:es.verdict].
Across the sample, 3 of 8 downgrade episodes had enough trades to measure [E:es.events], and the mean abnormal widening in the pre-event window was 100.3 bps [E:es.mean_pre].
The widening is tested against zero with a one-sided t-test t = 2.22, p = 0.0783 [E:es.ttest].
As a signal, the early-warning rule fired before 66.7% of downgrades, while the same rule fired on 0.0% of 28 random placebo dates [E:es.hit_rate][E:es.false_alarm].
In those episodes the median lead time when it fired was 62 days [E:es.lead].
Measured against the full move, the median share of total widening that happened before the action was 45% [E:es.pre_share].
Case study: Tata Motors Finance Ltd was downgraded from CRISIL AA to CRISIL AA- on 2019-08-14 [E:case.action][S:CRISIL01].
Before that, its abnormal spread was 144.4 bps above its baseline in the 30 days before the action (z = 5.9) [E:case.widening].
Put differently, the early-warning rule first fired 42 days before the action [E:case.lead].

The agency's rationale explains the action as follows: "CRISIL's analysis of TMFL's asset liability maturity (ALM) profile as of July 31, 2019 shows negative mismatch only in the 6 months to 1 year bucket (inflows include existing committed lines of credit upto 2 months). However, given the ability..." [R:CRISIL_TataMotorsFinanceLtd_2019-08-14.html#p13].
On the transition matrix, 3.1% of 32 AA-rated unit-years were downgraded within a year, and 100.0% of 3 A-rated unit-years were downgraded within a year [E:tm.down.AA][E:tm.down.A].
The historical one-year PD for A (from 3 unit-years) is 66.67% and five-year PD is 66.67% [E:pd.A].
By contrast, the median A spread of 506 bps implies a one-year PD of 10.64% at 45% LGD [E:imp.A].
Validation: 90.9% of 5,242 recomputed yields were within 5 bps of the exchange-printed yield [E:val.pass_rate], and the median absolute yield difference was 0.27 bps [E:val.median_diff].
